items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Buddy Bowling used to play in there. I can tell you, every band played in a band. ... Buddy Bowling, trumpet. ... Frank Lewis. ... Willie Connish played trombone. Jimmy Johnson played bass. James Phillips played drums.

ctx.x: They turned it into a church, finally got a steeple on it, and church windows, you know.

Well, that's what it was after we, old man, old man all the time. But you'd play a dance and then they'd have church on Sunday. Yeah, you'd play Saturday night, they'd dance there, and see. They used it for church? And they used it for Sunday for the church. Oh, I didn't know that. Old man Kenny would own the place. Then the outfathers hall was running down there on Padilla and the ramparts. Padilla and the Rampart. Smith was at that. Yeah, and Kenny's Hall was on Liberty and Padilla. Different class of people.…
